title: Jurassic World
tagline: Dinosaurs on show. Dinner on the table.
about: A fully working dinosaur theme park opens on Isla Nublar, and its newest creation escapes.

    StartersMosasaur feeding prawnsGarlic chilli lime butter prawns grilled and piled on a platterHow to make it600g green prawns, peeled3 garlic cloves, crushed2 red chillies, chopped3 limes, one zested and the rest in wedges60g butter, meltedToss the prawns with the garlic, red chillies, lime zest and melted butter.Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred.Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.Gyrosphere cheese ballsCheese balls in walnuts and paprika. Hamster ball, basically.How to make it200g cheddar, grated250g cream cheese2 tbsp snipped chives100g walnuts, finely chopped1 tbsp smoked paprika1 box water crackersMix the cheddar, cream cheese and chives. Roll into small balls.Coat in the walnuts mixed with the paprika.Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers.Main Street cinnamon sugar pretzelsBefore the pterosaurs hit Main Street.How to make itAs written, serves 4Soft pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, baked chewy and brown, brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with warm caramel dip.Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water into a dough, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour.Shape into 8 pretzels.Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.Bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Brush with 60g melted butter and toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.Serve with warmed caramel sauce.MainsIsla Nublar fish tacosChilli cumin flathead tacos with pineapple salsa, lime crema and cabbageHow to make it600g flathead fillets1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp salt2 tbsp oil1/2 pineapple, diced1/4 red onion, finely diced3 limes300ml sour cream8 corn tortillas1/4 small cabbage, shreddedDice the pineapple and onion and mix with lime juice for the salsa. Mix the sour cream with lime for the crema.Dust the flathead fillets in the chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry in the oil until just cooked. Flake into pieces.Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.Fill the tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.Owen's smoky beef short ribsOwen at his bungalow by the lakeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, slow cooked until they pull off the bone, glazed sticky, with buttered corn and slaw.Rub 2kg beef short ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp salt.Wrap tightly in foil and cook at 140°C for 5 hours.Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and roast at 220°C for 15 minutes until sticky.Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them.Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 4 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp vinegar.SweetsDino egg chocolate mousseChocolate mousse. Dinosaurs are "wow" enough.How to make it200g dark chocolate300ml thickened cream3 eggs, separated4 chocolate biscuits, crushed8 speckled chocolate eggsMelt the chocolate and cool slightly.Whip the cream and whisk the egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites.Spoon into glasses and chill for 2 hours.Top with crushed biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg.DrinksTheme park frozen lemonadeSlushy lemonade in big cups. Sponsored, like the Indominus rex.How to make it6 lemons, juiced150g caster sugar500ml water1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the lemon juice and water.Freeze in a tray for 2 hours.Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws.
